title: Terbium-fluorido cluster: an energy cage for photoluminescence

synthesis.procedure: Compound 1 was obtained by solvothermal reaction in DMF of the precursor [Tb2(piv)6(Hpiv)6] in the presence of NH4F as the fluoride source (full experimental details referred to the ESI). Single-crystal X-ray diffraction showed six Tb3+ ions linked by eight μ3-F ions into an octahedral core.
synthesis.temperature: 120 °C (heating); cooled to room temperature, then filtrate to −5 °C
synthesis.time: 10 min ultrasonication; 72 h heating; 2 days crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Single crystals of 1 were obtained and characterized by SCXRD; colorless crystals are implied by the ESI photograph/description in the communication context, but work-up quantities are not given in the main text.

properties.summary: Air-stable Tb6 fluorido cluster shows intense green solid-state photoluminescence without ligand antenna effect. Absolute quantum yield reaches 99.6% with a 2.03 ms 5D4 lifetime, attributed to confinement of energy migration within the cluster and suppression of O–H multi-phonon relaxation by fluoride bridges. Emission remains similar after 4 h water soaking but is quenched in strong acid or base.
